name: Lesotho

fees.name: Visitor visa - single entry
fees.validity: Single entry; approval letter issued as a 72-hour visa-on-arrival letter, visa endorsed at Maseru Port of Entry or Moshoeshoe I International Airport
fees.notes: M1000 (Maloti, pegged 1:1 to ZAR). Applications processed manually by Ministry of Home Affairs in Maseru via visa-applications.immigration@gov.ls; embassies do not issue visas. Diplomatic/official/UN passport and laissez-passer holders exempt from fees. amount_usd approximate.

fees.name: Visitor visa - multiple entry
fees.notes: M2000 (Maloti). Same email-based process via Ministry of Home Affairs. amount_usd approximate.

fees.name: e-Visa (SUSPENDED)
fees.notes: Ministry of Home Affairs states the eVisa application system (evisalesotho.com) is suspended; applicants must email VISA-Applications.Immigration@gov.ls. Historical e-visa fees were USD 150 single-entry / USD 250 multiple-entry per the 2017 government launch announcement (secondary confirmation via Fragomen), but no current official fee schedule is published, so amount is null.

vfs.note: VFS Global operates a Lesotho corridor from South Africa (visa.vfsglobal.com/zaf/en/lso). The published fixed VFS service fee at the Lesotho facilitation centres in South Africa is R1550 per applicant plus R185 biometric clearance fee (18+); this published figure relates to the Lesotho Exemption Permit programme and the visitor-visa service fee page was not directly retrievable (HTTP 403), so treat as indicative. Fees non-refundable.

free_visa_notes: Lesotho is visa-free for many nationalities (e.g. USA and GBR passport holders do not need a visa for short visits; SADC nationals visa-free). Fees above apply only to visa-required nationalities. No published reciprocity fee schedule by nationality was found; the flat M1000/M2000 fees apply to all standard passports, with fee exemptions for diplomatic/official/UN passports.
